studies.intro: Efficacy studies use independent pre/post tests with comparison cohorts (school, grade). Students see no score and get no XP; every figure is computed by the system with small cells hidden.
studies.title: Study title
studies.createHelp: Forms A/B are published efficacy blueprint versions of the same subject/grade covering exactly the selected objectives.
studies.subject: Subject (subject_id)
studies.activateConfirm: Activation assigns the empty arms and locks pairs and forms. Continue?
studies.completeConfirm: Complete the study? No further test wave can be scheduled.

agreements.tenants: Pick tenants to see their agreements
agreements.pickTenants: Pick at least one tenant to see the agreements (cross-tenant reads are audited).
agreements.revokeHelp: Revoking withdraws every student of the tenant from the running studies and moves them back to the control arm of every experiment.

waves.noScores: Test waves never release scores to students nor create mastery evidence; the list only shows the counts.
waves.scheduleHelp: The post-test opens at least {{weeks}} weeks after the pre-test closes.

withdraw.help: Done on the written request of the school. The derived data of the students leave every report and dataset created afterwards; they keep learning as usual.
withdraw.done: {{count}} students withdrawn; {{sessions}} exam sessions not yet open cancelled.

report.title: Efficacy report
report.failed: The report failed. Try again later.
report.descriptiveOnly: Fewer cohorts per arm than the recommended sample: descriptive statistics only.
report.attritionWarning: Attrition is above the warning threshold.
report.effect: Effect size (Hedges' g, 95% CI adjusted for the design effect)
report.noEffect: Not enough data for an effect size (small cells hidden).

dataset.title: Pseudonymised dataset
dataset.help: CSV with one row per participant and pseudonymous codes only; the download link expires and every export is audited.

experiments.intro: Experiments only change the student experience; school reports, XP and exams always use the active model. The system stops an experiment when an arm lowers accuracy beyond the threshold.
experiments.unitHelp: By cohort (school, grade): every student of a cohort is always in the same arm.
experiments.createHelp: 2–5 arms, exactly one control, allocations adding up to 100%. Every tenant needs an agreement covering A/B experiments.
experiments.liveConfirm: Go live: the students of the test arms will see the new experience. Continue?
experiments.stopHelp: Students go back to the control arm from their next request; nothing already published is published again.
experiments.noResults: No results yet (the guardrail job runs daily).
experiments.guardrailBreached: Guardrail tripped: an arm is below the control by the threshold or more.

cohorts.conflictYes: Cohort has students in two arms — to resolve
cohorts.addHelp: A cohort is the grade of the study in one school of the target tenant; the tenant needs a valid agreement covering efficacy research.
cohorts.removeConfirm: Remove the cohort from the draft study?
cohorts.locked: The study is active: cohort pairs, arms and forms are locked.
